verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs show it ships CI/CD and a GitLab Runner you can install on your own cluster, and a community report confirms teams run self-hosted CI workers. Platform-hosted runners are only implied by that same community report ("even self-hosted ones"), and nothing documents centralized visibility across hosted and private runners. The report of CI workers failing to run is a reliability complaint, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: first-party docs for platform-hosted runners, documentation of centralized runner/pipeline visibility across hosted and private runners, and independent hands-on corroboration of the hybrid runner setup.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run pipelines on platform-hosted runners or my own private runners with centralized visibility
